name: Zankaja
summary: In Orgrimmar, young Zankaja waits anxiously for word of her mate, Dogran. He serves at the Crossroads, along the dangerous frontier of the Barrens.

sections.title: A Watchful Heart
sections.body: In Orgrimmar, Zankaja waits for news of Dogran, her mate. After earning a promotion, he went south to strengthen the Crossroads outpost in the Barrens. The assignment honors a warrior, but the frontier is harsh. Quilboar, centaur, and aggressive beasts threaten those who serve there. When Dogran failed to send word or return as expected, Zankaja began asking travelers to seek news of him.

sections.title: Tragic Tidings
sections.body: Word from the Barrens brings Zankaja her worst fear: Dogran fell into the clutches of the quilboar. Within Orgrimmar's canyon walls, she still holds hope. Yet the frontier is unforgiving, and the reports travelers bring paint a grim picture of sacrifice on the Horde's perilous borders.

faq.answer: Zankaja lives along the path between the Valley of Strength and the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Dogran is Zankaja's mate, an orc warrior recently promoted and sent to a station at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
Dogran was sent to duty at the Crossroads in the harsh Barrens, then failed to return or send word home. Zankaja fears harm has come to him on the frontier.

faq.q: What does Zankaja ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Zankaja asks passing travelers heading out of Orgrimmar to visit Captain Gazrog at the Crossroads and ask about Dogran's whereabouts and wellbeing.

faq.q: What happened to Dogran in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Zankaja does not know what happened to Dogran in the Barrens. She asks travelers to speak with Gazrog at the Crossroads and follow the trail from there.

angles.text: As an orc, you can see the personal cost to ordinary families in Durotar. Duty to the Warchief's new realm sends loved ones into untamed, lethal frontiers.
As a member of the Horde, you can see in Zankaja's plea what it costs to hold outposts like the Crossroads. Grunts stationed there face real bloodshed and sacrifice.
